title: test_selfdoc's backlog row test passes although kb/_self/tools.md has no row for fire, fmt, goal, list or release
goal: test_selfdoc.py's backlog row test fails when a backlog.py subcommand has no row in kb/_self/tools.md (it asserts the set of subcommands minus the named rows is empty), and kb/_self/tools.md has a row for fire, fmt, goal, list and release; found in the review of SP-6eifcza6 (the goal of ST-2ctgp2zi was one row per subcommand)

run: import subprocess,sys,re;h=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','-h'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout;names=re.search(r'\{([a-z,-]+)\}',h).group(1).split(',');t=open('kb/_self/tools.md',encoding='utf-8').read();sys.exit(1 if [n for n in names if '`python3 _tools/backlog.py '+n+'`' not in t] else 0)

repro_reason: the defect is a test that passes with rows missing; the observable is the table's text, read against the subcommand list the tool prints
